findings: Verified closeout repair: the only path to controller.submit is CompletionBridge.advance(), and both routes into it (tick selected-work phase and finish() after disposition) check paused plus the runtime_blocks controls entry under admission.lock; a failed operator-inbox read blocks dispatch and holds durable INTENT at zero attempts.

Verified closeout repair: completion-triggered packets now carry the same bounded coordinator census as scheduled reports via the observation's coordinator_context (24-task cap, reason truncation, no private bindings).

Minor: completion_bridge.py ingest() skips already-ingested jobs via continue without clearing completion_blocks, so a block from an earlier transient failure or a reverted identity change persists indefinitely in status and the census; fail-closed but misleading to operators.

Suggestion: handover_runtime.py _bookkeep() stamps family:'claude' into the published review receipt unconditionally; the broker-reported actual_model is recorded but never verified to be a Claude model, so the published fresh-review identity rests entirely on broker routing. Verify actual_model before attach.

Minor: update_consumed_handover_fixture.py compares ledger_before/ledger_after only after systemctl start, so ADMISSION_CHANGED_DURING_UPDATE detects rather than prevents admission drift and leaves the new configuration live with no receipt; verify the ledger before restarting services.

Minor: Runtime.recover() overwrites a blocked task's original reason with RECOVERY_EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE on failed retrieval, losing the prior diagnostic, and re-polls permanently blocked tasks via stage_status every tick with no cap.

Minor: once one report's delivery hits the retry ceiling, subsequent reports fail preparation with REPORT_PUBLICATION_BASELINE_MOVED because the dedicated checkout HEAD retains the unpushed commit; correctly fail-closed (no wrong publication) but the delivery queue wedges until manual reconcile and deserves an explicit queued-behind-blocked reason.

Authority and approvals preserved: dispatch is limited to the single configured synthetic successor with exact-proposal equality and maximum_dispatches 1; declines are honored without dispatch; installer/updater refuse overwrite and partial state and add no timers, credentials, or model turns; scientific gates, patient-data exclusions, and live-activation gates are untouched.

investigator_disposition.control_failure: Resolved by reviewed advance gate; actual historical review and evidence preserved.
investigator_disposition.completion_block: Historical identity-change blocks intentionally remain visible pending reconciliation; do not silently clear an integrity finding solely because identity later matches.
investigator_disposition.review_family: Accept small defensive actual-model check before attaching family attribution.
investigator_disposition.update_ledger: Accept pre-restart equality check, preserving post-restart verification.
investigator_disposition.recovery: Preserve prior diagnostic. Deterministic read-only polling of known uncertain work remains permitted; it spends no model admission and does not retry execution.
investigator_disposition.publication_queue: Explicitly document queued-behind-unpublished candidate reconciliation. It must not overwrite or silently rebuild a blocked candidate.
